decisions.verified: Two original full 275-card BCP/MCB lists independently reconciled, plus five complete original numbered insert lists and corresponding teams.
decisions.names: Four reviewed variants #39 Bobby Abreu, #47 David Justice, #70 Bobby Higginson and #270 Timo Perez.
decisions.baseShortPrint: Only single-player Prospects #251-275 were SP, one every four packs; 226-250 duals were regular.
decisions.medallions: Original 275 Gold G suffix (251G-275G SP 1:24); 275 Platinum P suffix 1P-250P /50, 251P-275P /25.
decisions.inserts: Four numbered insert groups total 50; corresponding true Platinum /10 variants total 50; Fall Classics 37, 26 game-used, nine signed memorabilia.
decisions.platinumRC: Five /1499 cards #276-280 were in 2001 Fleer Platinum, not original Ultra; isolated outside base checklist; two-player printed RC never proves both individual true rookies.
decisions.sharedPrograms: 2001 Fleer Autographics, Feel the Game and Season Pass span multiple Fleer brands; omit until individual Ultra-channel checklists and allocation are verified.
decisions.collation: 10 cards/hobby pack, 24 packs/box; guaranteed Gold, range-specific SP, serialed, cross-product exclusions and hobby/retail split cannot all be represented by single oddsPerPack integer. Null rather than fabricated odds.
decisions.design: No scans, cards, relic images, logos, autographs or pack art invented; released false until original imagery, prices and odds reviewed.
